about: Official schedule changes the news feed doesn't carry yet (e.g. notices posted only on X, or times the feed gets wrong). scripts/update-schedule.mjs applies each entry to the event with that id and name. `feed` is what the feed gave when the entry was written (Americas ISO time, or null); once the feed gives something else, the feed wins and the entry is skipped and reported, so delete it then. `start`/`end` are server-time dates (the same wall-clock time on each server); `startInstant`/`endInstant` are one instant, given as the Americas/Europe wall-clock time (the Asia server is 13 h ahead); `permanent` sets the event's end to null (a timed phase that became a permanent activity). `availability` replaces the event's availability text; `note` is added to the event's details.
